news.titleEn: Inflation remained elevated in October, CPI report shows, upping odds of Fed interest rate hike
news.conclusionEn: US consumer prices rose 0.4% in October and core prices 0.3%, both above forecasts, all but locking in a Fed rate hike in December.
news.conclusionZh: 美国10月CPI环比涨0.4%超预期，12月加息几成定局
news.whyEn: A Fed hike would raise borrowing costs worldwide, pressure stocks and push the dollar higher, affecting mortgages, loans and emerging markets.
news.whyZh: 美联储加息将推高全球融资成本，压制股市、推升美元
news.detailEn: Headline CPI rose 0.4% month-on-month and core CPI 0.3%, each a tenth above economists' expectations; core has now risen 0.3% for three straight months. Shelter accounted for over 30% of the increase while food prices accelerated to 0.5%. CME FedWatch now prices roughly an 85% chance of a quarter-point hike in December and about 15% odds of a half-point move. Fed Governor Waller has said a 0.3% core print would incline him toward a larger hike, keeping a 50-basis-point move on the table.
news.detailZh: 10月整体CPI环比上涨0.4%，核心CPI上涨0.3%，均比预期高0.1个百分点，核心通胀已连续三个月保持0.3%。住房成本贡献了三成以上涨幅，食品价格涨幅升至0.5%。CME FedWatch显示，市场预计12月加息25个基点的概率约85%，加息50个基点的概率约15%。美联储理事沃勒此前表示，若核心通胀为0.3%，他倾向支持更大幅度加息，因此“加息50基点”仍有可能。

news.titleEn: Anthropic sets IPO price range of $70 to $78, looks to start trading Nov. 19
news.conclusionEn: Anthropic set its IPO at $70–$78 a share for 825 million shares, implying a valuation of up to about $1.4 trillion, with Nasdaq trading targeted for Nov. 19.
news.conclusionZh: Anthropic定价区间70-78美元，估值最高约1.4万亿美元
news.whyEn: It could be the largest IPO ever, a key test of public-market appetite for AI and a major liquidity event for the whole AI sector.
news.whyZh: 有望成史上最大IPO，检验公开市场对AI的真实胃口
news.detailEn: The company plans to list on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT, pricing on Nov. 18 and raising up to $64.35 billion at the top of the range. Tech partners including AMD, Broadcom, Google, Micron, Microsoft, Nvidia and TSMC will buy $26 billion of stock in a concurrent private placement. Anthropic reported $33.24 billion of revenue in the first nine months of 2026 and a run-rate near $81 billion as of October. About 20% of shares are earmarked for retail investors, well above the typical 5–10%.
news.detailZh: 公司计划以代码ANT在纳斯达克上市，11月18日定价，按区间上限可募资最高643.5亿美元。AMD、博通、谷歌、美光、微软、英伟达和台积电等合作方将通过同步私募认购260亿美元股票。Anthropic披露2026年前九个月营收332.4亿美元，截至10月的年化营收约810亿美元。约20%的股份将分配给散户，远高于通常5%-10%的比例。

news.titleEn: Nvidia sells off for second day in fallout from Jensen Huang's affair with alleged spy
news.conclusionEn: Nvidia shares fell another 5.5% as Trump confirmed the FBI is investigating CEO Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese intelligence asset.
news.conclusionZh: 英伟达再跌5.5%，特朗普确认FBI调查黄仁勋事件
news.whyEn: Nvidia is the AI trade's bellwether and a top index weight; leadership uncertainty hits the S&P 500, Nasdaq and the wider chip supply chain.
news.whyZh: 英伟达是AI行情风向标和指数权重股，管理层风险波及整个大盘
news.detailEn: After a 4% drop on Monday, Nvidia slid 5.47% on Tuesday and briefly fell below a $4 trillion market value, while rivals AMD and Broadcom gained. Huang admitted the affair in a staff email; the woman, an executive at Nvidia customer Megaspeed, was reportedly judged by US officials to be a Chinese intelligence asset. Trump said the FBI is investigating but that Huang would be "in good shape". A shareholder class action has been filed, and analysts expect the board's probe to take four to six weeks.
news.detailZh: 英伟达周一下跌4%后，周二再跌5.47%，盘中市值一度跌破4万亿美元，竞争对手AMD和博通则上涨。黄仁勋在给员工的邮件中承认婚外情；据报道，美国官员认定该女子（英伟达客户Megaspeed的高管）为中国情报人员。特朗普表示FBI正在调查，但认为黄仁勋「会没事」。目前已有股东提起集体诉讼，分析师预计董事会调查需4-6周。

news.titleEn: Gold falls more than 2% as CPI tops forecasts, lifting dollar and yields
news.conclusionEn: Gold dropped nearly 3% toward $4,000 an ounce as the hot CPI print pushed up the dollar and Treasury yields.
news.conclusionZh: CPI超预期推高美元和美债收益率，金价跌近3%
news.whyEn: Rising yields raise the cost of holding non-yielding assets; the 10-year yield nearing 5% tightens financial conditions for borrowers and investors globally.
news.whyZh: 美债收益率逼近5%，黄金、加密等无息资产承压
news.detailEn: Spot gold fell about 2.8% to around $4,021 an ounce and silver dropped 3.9% after the inflation data. Traders lifted the odds of a 50-basis-point December hike from zero to roughly 10%, strengthening the dollar. Higher yields increase the opportunity cost of holding bullion, though gold remains above the $4,000 mark. The risk-off move also hit Bitcoin, which briefly slid below $73,000.
news.detailZh: 通胀数据公布后，现货金价下跌约2.8%至每盎司4021美元左右，白银下跌3.9%。交易员将12月加息50基点的概率从0上调至约10%，美元走强。收益率上升提高了持有黄金的机会成本，但金价仍守在4000美元上方。避险情绪同样冲击比特币，盘中一度跌破7.3万美元。

news.titleEn: Oil prices continue to fall on hopes of US-Iran peace deal talks
news.conclusionEn: Brent fell to about $91 and WTI to about $85 as Trump said further strikes on Iran were unlikely, extending a roughly 20% monthly slide.
news.conclusionZh: 美伊和谈预期升温，油价本月累计跌约20%
news.whyEn: Cheaper oil eases inflation pressure and fuel costs worldwide, and could change the rate path for central banks that hiked during the war.
news.whyZh: 油价回落缓解全球通胀与燃油成本，影响各国央行加息节奏
news.detailEn: Brent crude dropped 1.31% to $91.36 a barrel and WTI fell 1.59% to $85.47. Trump cited "positive momentum" after meeting Qatar's prime minister and called further strikes "quite unlikely", while saying the US remains ready to act. Both benchmarks have lost about 20% this month as traders bet on an end to the seven-month conflict. The war had earlier driven inflation higher and pushed central banks to raise rates, so a lasting deal would be a significant disinflationary force.
news.detailZh: 布伦特原油下跌1.31%至每桶91.36美元，WTI下跌1.59%至85.47美元。特朗普在会见卡塔尔首相后称局势有「积极势头」，认为再次打击伊朗「不太可能」，但美方仍随时准备行动。交易员押注持续七个月的冲突即将结束，两大基准油价本月已累计下跌约20%。这场战争此前推高通胀并迫使多国央行加息，若达成持久协议，将带来明显的通胀降温效应。

news.titleEn: China's goods surplus tops $1 trillion for a second year amid calls for Beijing to rebalance trade
news.conclusionEn: China's exports jumped 35.2% in October and its trade surplus passed $1 trillion for the first 10 months of 2026, driven by AI hardware demand.
news.conclusionZh: 中国10月出口增35.2%，前10月顺差破万亿美元
news.whyEn: The surplus fuels trade friction with the US and EU just as the US-China trade truce expires in January, while showing China's central role in the AI supply chain.
news.whyZh: 巨额顺差加剧贸易摩擦，中美休战协议明年1月到期
news.detailEn: October exports rose 35.2% year-on-year, beating forecasts of 33.5%, while imports surged 41.6%, the fastest since May 2021. The surplus for January–October reached $1.04 trillion, hitting the milestone faster than last year's record $1.2 trillion full-year total. Semiconductor exports more than doubled, and shipments of data-center equipment such as cables and racks soared. Analysts warn export growth could slow to about 8% in 2027 as base effects fade, and the IMF and trading partners continue to press Beijing to boost domestic consumption.
news.detailZh: 10月出口同比增长35.2%，高于预期的33.5%；进口大增41.6%，为2021年5月以来最快。1-10月贸易顺差达1.04万亿美元，突破万亿的速度快于去年（去年全年顺差创纪录达1.2万亿美元）。芯片出口额翻倍以上，线缆、机架等数据中心设备出口大增。分析师警告，随着基数效应消退，2027年出口增速可能放缓至8%左右；IMF和贸易伙伴持续敦促中国扩大内需。

news.titleEn: Russia and Ukraine hold nearly 4 hours of U.S.-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi
news.conclusionEn: Russia and Ukraine held their first US-brokered talks in nine months in Abu Dhabi, focused on prisoner swaps and security guarantees, with no breakthrough yet.
news.conclusionZh: 俄乌9个月来首次在阿布扎比和谈，暂无突破
news.whyEn: Progress toward ending the war would reshape European security, energy markets and defense spending; failure would prolong sanctions and uncertainty.
news.whyZh: 和谈进展关系欧洲安全、能源市场与军费走向
news.detailEn: The trilateral session, led on the US side by Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff, lasted nearly four hours, with a second day scheduled for Wednesday. Zelenskyy called it "constructive and quite substantive" and Secretary of State Rubio described it as very productive. Talks covered humanitarian issues such as prisoner exchanges and abducted children, plus security guarantees. Core positions remain far apart: Moscow seeks territorial concessions and a Ukrainian renunciation of NATO, while Kyiv refuses to cede land.
news.detailZh: 此次三方会谈由库什纳和威特科夫率美方代表团，持续近四小时，周三将继续第二天谈判。泽连斯基称会谈「建设性且相当实质」，国务卿鲁比奥称「非常有成效」。议题包括交换战俘、被带走儿童等人道问题以及安全保障。但双方核心立场仍相距甚远：俄方要求领土让步并让乌克兰放弃加入北约，乌方拒绝割让领土。

news.titleEn: SoftBank swings to $7 billion loss after U.S. data center hit and Intel share decline
news.conclusionEn: SoftBank posted a ¥1.12 trillion ($7 billion) quarterly loss after writing down US data-center power equipment and losing on its Intel stake.
news.conclusionZh: 软银季度巨亏70亿美元，AI数据中心投资受挫
news.whyEn: As OpenAI's biggest backer and a heavy borrower, SoftBank is a barometer of the financial strain behind the AI infrastructure buildout.
news.whyZh: 软银是OpenAI最大金主，其亏损反映AI基建的财务压力
news.detailEn: The fiscal second-quarter loss compares with a ¥2.5 trillion profit a year earlier. A $3.7 billion hit came from scaling back advance purchases of power-generation equipment for US AI data centers, and declines in listed holdings such as Intel also weighed. SoftBank's cumulative $54.6 billion investment in OpenAI carries a fair value of $99.6 billion, a gain that remains on paper until a listing. The company raised a record $56.5 billion in the quarter, largely through debt, to fund its AI ambitions.
news.detailZh: 去年同期软银盈利2.5万亿日元，本季转为亏损。其中37亿美元损失来自缩减为美国AI数据中心预购的发电设备，英特尔等上市持仓下跌也拖累业绩。软银对OpenAI累计投资546亿美元，公允价值996亿美元，但这部分收益在OpenAI上市前仍只是账面浮盈。本季软银创纪录融资565亿美元（主要靠举债），用于支撑其AI布局。

businessTips.explanationEn: The cash conversion cycle measures how many days it takes a business to turn cash spent on inventory back into cash collected from customers: days inventory outstanding + days sales outstanding − days payables outstanding. A shorter cycle means less money is tied up in operations, so the business needs less financing to grow. It explains why some profitable companies still run out of cash. Improving it is often cheaper than raising new capital.
businessTips.explanationZh: 现金转换周期衡量企业从花钱进货到从客户手里收回现金需要多少天：存货周转天数＋应收账款天数－应付账款天数。周期越短，被运营占用的资金越少，扩张时需要的外部融资也越少。这也解释了为什么有些公司账面盈利却依然会现金断裂。缩短这个周期，往往比找人融资更便宜。
businessTips.exampleEn: A wholesaler holds stock for 45 days, gets paid by customers in 30 days and pays suppliers in 20 days, so its CCC is 55 days. Negotiating 40-day supplier terms and offering a small discount for early customer payment could cut it to around 25 days, freeing up cash without a loan.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一家批发商存货平均放45天，客户30天付款，自己20天付供应商，现金转换周期是55天。如果把供应商账期谈到40天，再给提前付款的客户一点折扣，周期可缩到约25天，不借钱也能腾出一大笔现金。

businessTips.explanationEn: Bootstrapping means building a business with your own savings and customer revenue instead of outside investors. You keep full ownership and control, and the discipline of needing paying customers early forces you to find real demand fast. The trade-off is slower growth and more personal financial risk. It suits service businesses, niche products and side hustles where upfront costs are low.
businessTips.explanationZh: 自力更生（Bootstrapping）指不找外部投资，只用自己的积蓄和客户收入来发展生意。好处是保留全部股权和决策权，而且“必须尽早有付费客户”的压力会逼你快速验证真实需求。代价是增长较慢、个人承担的财务风险更大。它特别适合前期投入小的服务型生意、小众产品和副业。
businessTips.exampleEn: Someone starting a bookkeeping side business might use a laptop and free software, sign three clients through their network, and reinvest the first months of fees into accounting software and a simple website. Only once revenue is steady do they hire help, never giving up equity.
businessTips.exampleZh: 比如做记账副业，先用自己的电脑和免费软件，通过熟人签下三个客户，再把头几个月的收入投到专业记账软件和简单官网上。等收入稳定了再请帮手，全程不用出让任何股份。

businessTips.explanationEn: Before an IPO, the company and its underwriters set an indicative price range and then run a "bookbuilding" process, collecting orders from institutional investors at different prices. Strong demand can push the final price to the top of, or above, the range; weak demand can force a cut. The final price, the number of shares and the fully diluted share count together determine the valuation. Watching whether a deal is upsized or repriced is a useful signal of market sentiment.
businessTips.explanationZh: 公司上市前，会和承销商先定一个参考价格区间，再进行「簿记建档」，即收集机构投资者在不同价位的认购订单。需求旺盛时，最终发行价可能落在区间上限甚至上调区间；需求疲软则可能被迫降价。最终发行价、发行股数和完全摊薄后的总股本共同决定估值。观察一单IPO是否扩大发行规模或调整价格，是判断市场情绪的好信号。
businessTips.exampleEn: Anthropic set a $70–$78 range for 825 million shares, with pricing on Nov. 18. If orders are heavily oversubscribed, the price could be raised above $78; at the $74 midpoint, the implied valuation is lower than the roughly $1.4 trillion headline figure based on the top of the range.
businessTips.exampleZh: Anthropic为8.25亿股设定70-78美元区间，11月18日定价。如果认购严重超额，价格可能上调到78美元以上；若按中间价74美元计算，估值会低于按区间上限算出的约1.4万亿美元。
